title: Configure a door schedule, renumber marks, and publish it on a sheet
task: Turn a category schedule into a usable door schedule and publish it: create a door ViewSchedule, add Mark/Family/Type/Level/Width/Height columns by schedulable-field parameter id, sort by Level then Mark, renumber every door's Mark, then place the schedule on a titled sheet with ScheduleSheetInstance -- a schedule cannot be exported directly.

pitfalls.symptom: Document.ExportImage (or Export) with a ViewSchedule's id throws ArgumentException 'some of the views is not exportable' (parameter name: views) and writes no file.
pitfalls.cause: A schedule is not a printable/exportable view.
pitfalls.fix: Place the schedule on a sheet with ScheduleSheetInstance.Create and export the SHEET instead.

pitfalls.symptom: AddField never adds the Family, Type, or Level column when matched against ALL_MODEL_FAMILY_NAME / ALL_MODEL_TYPE_NAME.
pitfalls.cause: In a schedule, Family/Type/Level are 'special' schedulable fields whose SchedulableField.ParameterId is a negative BuiltInParameter -- ELEM_FAMILY_PARAM, ELEM_TYPE_PARAM, SCHEDULE_LEVEL_PARAM -- not the ALL_MODEL_* name parameters.
pitfalls.fix: Match GetSchedulableFields by ELEM_FAMILY_PARAM / ELEM_TYPE_PARAM / SCHEDULE_LEVEL_PARAM; Mark and dimensions use their normal BuiltInParameter (ALL_MODEL_MARK, GENERIC_WIDTH, DOOR_HEIGHT).

pitfalls.symptom: Adding a 'From Room: Name' vs 'To Room: Name' column by ParameterId picks the wrong or an ambiguous field.
pitfalls.cause: For a door schedule, both 'From Room: Name' and 'To Room: Name' report the SAME SchedulableField.ParameterId (ROOM_NAME); they cannot be told apart by id.
pitfalls.fix: Disambiguate room-side fields by SchedulableField.GetName(document) instead of by ParameterId.

pitfalls.symptom: NewFamilyInstance for a door hosted in an upper-level wall fails at commit with 'Can't cut instance of <type> out of Wall'.
pitfalls.cause: The insertion point's z was below the wall body (e.g. 0 while the wall sits at the level's elevation).
pitfalls.fix: Place the hosted door at the host wall's level elevation -- set the insertion point z to level.Elevation.
